leads.name: Boundary oak and old mulberries, Charlecote Park
leads.reason: National Trust 'Our work at Charlecote' page (nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/warwickshire/charlecote-park/our-work-at-charlecote-park) names a roughly 300-year-old boundary oak and mulberries as the estate's eldest trees, seed collected from them. Seen only in a search summary of that page; the fetched page is JS-rendered with no text. No location of the oak inside the 180-acre park, no girth. No pin, no photo, no recognition line: stays a lead. Ask the NT or find the tree-walk leaflet.
